items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Well, the big minstrel shows, I mean, like L.J.'s Field, I seen them, I mean, years ago I seen them at the Tulane Theatre

ctx.x: Did they ever have many minstrel shows here, or was that mostly for the country out on the road, or what?
Well, the big minstrel shows, I mean, like L.J.'s Field, I seen them, I mean, years ago I seen them at the Tulane Theatre, I mean, I seen them, I seen them, my uncle take them, I see them.
While we're on that subject of minstrels, when you were playing on your chairs, do you remember any of the songs you learned?
